answer_1.quote: We address this by measuring and benchmarking to what degree LLMs can amplify or diminish persuasive language when instructed to rewrite various texts to sound more or less persuasive, or when instructed to merely paraphrase text.
answer_1.outputs: Paraphrased texts with varying degrees of persuasive language

answer_2.quote: We fine-tune a regression model on the pairwise data using the pre-trained DebertaV3-Large model using a Mean Square Error Loss.
automatic_metrics: Regression model scoring relative persuasive language

answer_4.quote: We obtain annotations through crowdsourcing of the persuasive pairs by using three annotators for each text pair on multiple batches.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to select which sentence in a pair uses the most persuasive language and judge by 'how much more' using a scale (marginally, moderately, or heavily more).
